adjudication_protocol: Consensus evaluation synthesizing observational evidence against normative reference profiles.

pkg_11_physics_thermodynamics.topic: The Carnot Cycle, Maximum Theoretical Efficiency, and Entropy

children.name: Heat Engine Energy Balance W = Q_H - Q_C
State Variable Entropy Definition dS = dQ_rev / T

IDENTIFICATION.evidence: Definitions of thermal reservoirs, heat engines, and net work given in opening segment.

MEANING.evidence: Carnot principle explained: reversible engine efficiency is theoretical maximum between two reservoirs.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.evidence: Complete detailed walkthrough of all 4 processes: 2 isothermals and 2 adiabatics with volume ratios.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.evidence: P-V area representing net cycle work, First Law energy conservation W = Q_H - Q_C.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.evidence: Step-by-step mathematical proof: isothermal heat expressions and adiabatic volume cancellations yielding eta = 1 - T_C/T_H.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.evidence: Full numerical execution for turbine engine: T_H=800K, T_C=300K, Q_H=2000J -> eta=62.5%, W=1250J, Q_C=750J.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.evidence: Passing disclaimer only: noted that real-world friction causes irreversibility, but omitted Clausius inequality and entropy generation.

IDENTIFICATION.diagnosis: Heat engine components and energy reservoirs defined.

MEANING.diagnosis: Carnot principle and reversibility explained thoroughly.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.diagnosis: All four thermodynamic cycle processes explained in detail.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.diagnosis: Energy balance and work enclosed in P-V cycle established.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.diagnosis: Mathematical derivation of Carnot efficiency proved rigorously.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.diagnosis: Complete numerical cycle problem executed step-by-step.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.diagnosis: Clausius inequality and irreversible entropy generation omitted due to time limits; passing disclaimer capped at Level 1.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.diagnosis: Reversed refrigeration cycles outside primary heat engine objective.

pkg_12_pharmacology_clearance.topic: One-Compartment Intravenous Pharmacokinetics: Clearance and Half-Life

children.name: Primary Parameters (Dose, C_0, V_d, k_e, CL, t_1/2)
Exponential Decay Derivation C(t) = C_0 e^(-k_e t)

IDENTIFICATION.evidence: Named Dose, C_0, V_d, k_e, clearance, half-life.

MEANING.evidence: One-compartment open kinetic model explained: body as well-mixed container with instant drug distribution.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.evidence: Definitions of V_d, k_e, clearance, half-life.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.evidence: Lecturer taught simple univariate decay; omitted multi-compartment alpha distribution vs beta elimination phase interactions required by curriculum.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.evidence: Integrated dC/dt = -k_e*C step-by-step; derived t_1/2 = 0.693/k_e and CL = k_e * V_d.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.evidence: Complete clinical case: 500mg IV, C_0=25mg/L -> V_d=20L, k_e=0.1/hr -> CL=2L/hr, t_1/2=6.93hr, C(12)=7.53mg/L.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.evidence: Passing disclaimer only: admitted capacity-limited Michaelis-Menten elimination (phenytoin/overdose) was omitted.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.evidence: Brief passing mention of chronic dosing.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.diagnosis: Expected multi-compartment distribution vs elimination phase dynamics; lecture restricted to single-compartment decay.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.diagnosis: Differential decay and half-life derived rigorously.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.diagnosis: Non-linear Michaelis-Menten saturation kinetics explicitly declared in objective but omitted in lecture; passing disclaimer capped at Level 1.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.diagnosis: Chronic multiple-dosing regimens outside bolus lecture scope.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.evidence: Worked formalization of 'Every philosopher admires some logician' and truth testing in concrete 3-element model.

DFT Analysis Equation and Frequency Bins
